feeds.title: My Gluten Free Guide
feeds.description: Here you will find everything you need to know about being gluten free and living successfully as a coeliac. It can be a daunting prospect when you are first diagnosed with coeliac disease (read about my coeliac disease diagnosis to learn more), but I promise it is totally manageable. Since my diagnosis 18 years ago, I have had to follow a strict gluten free diet and I have LOTS of tips to share.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Blogger
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah Howells, aka The Gluten Free Blogger. I share gluten-free recipes and advice for living life with coeliac disease. From simple gluten-free bakes to meal ideas, coeliac humor, and more, The Gluten-Free Blogger has everything you need to start living and loving your gluten-free life.

feeds.title: Gluten-Free Heaven
feeds.description: Gluten-Free Heaven is the UK's only magazine dedicated to free-from cooking and baking. Each issue features 101 inspiring seasonal recipes, plus essential advice, interviews with the experts, competitions and all the latest product news.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Alice
feeds.description: This blog is authored by Alice, a 24 year old gluten & dairy free food blogger from the UK sharing recipes, new finds, favourite places to eat out and more!

feeds.title: Coeliac Sanctuary
feeds.description: A gluten-free blog, covering gluten-free, coeliac safe places to eat, gluten-free recipes, blogs, reviews, coeliac travel cards.

feeds.title: From The Larder - A Gluten-Free Food Blog
feeds.description: Georgina Hartley is a Gluten-free food blogger, market trader and cake maker, based in North London. She bake a lot, eat a lot and love writing about her gluten-free kitchen adventures here.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Alchemist
feeds.description: A gluten free cooking blog exploring the world of gluten free ingredients and food creation

feeds.title: Glutarama
feeds.description: 100's of Free From recipes, with gluten free, dairy free and vegan options. Life is full of drama's especially with a family touched by Coeliac Disease, Type 1 Diabetes, Autism and Intolerance's at Glutarama, gluten free is the easy bit!

feeds.title: Gluten Free Mrs D - A Gluten Free Travel Blog
feeds.description: Your guide to gluten free travel in the UK and around the world.

feeds.title: Kasia's Plate
feeds.description: A blog for everything gluten and dairy-free. This is everything from recipe creations to food reviews. Our mission is to bring to you a collection of wonderful gluten and dairy-free gems. Anything from snacks to restaurants and take aways.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Cuppa Tea
feeds.description: Gluten free blog based in London, UK. Tried & tested award-winning recipes that are low FODMAP & dairy free too. Follow this blog for plenty of recipes & reviews that are applicable to those living gluten free, dairy free, sugar free, egg free & even living a vegan life style.

feeds.title: Mandy's Gluten Free
feeds.description: Mandy Bond founder of Gluten Free Food Products Limited shares her Gluten Free Recipes. Reviews Gluten Free products. And shares Gluten Free Eating Out experiences.
